basics.name: Pedro Azevedo
basics.label: Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering Manager with a strong technical foundation in distributed systems and cloud-native architecture. Proven track record of scaling engineering teams, leading digital transformations, and bridging the gap between complex business requirements and high-performance technical execution.

positions.summary: Dual-hat role managing organizational growth while maintaining technical leadership. Responsible for hiring, team health, and aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.
highlights: Scale multidisciplinary engineering teams through structured hiring and onboarding processes.
Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure predictable delivery of high-impact features.
Led the end-to-end delivery of greenfield integration projects for a global web platform.
Championed internal development programs to upskill engineers and improve team retention.
Oversee the development and maintenance of high-traffic web and mobile applications.

positions.summary: Designed and implemented scalable cloud-native solutions within a distributed systems environment.
highlights: Developed high-throughput distributed systems using C# and Azure.
Modernized legacy ERP applications, improving performance and maintainability.
Provided technical mentorship and code reviews to maintain high quality standards across the codebase.

work.name: Capgemini (RDI Software)
work.summary: Played a key role in a major digital transformation for a global QSR client (McDonald's), progressing from Developer to Architect.
highlights: Orchestrated a project expansion from a single team to over 10 cross-functional squads.
Led the architectural transition from a C++ monolith to a C# microservices-based distributed system.
Implemented Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to ensure a scalable and maintainable system architecture.
Automated CI/CD pipelines, significantly reducing deployment cycles and manual overhead.
Built real-time collaboration tools using WebSockets to improve operational efficiency.

positions.summary: Strategic technical leadership for a large-scale digital transformation.
highlights: Guided architectural discussions across Backend, Frontend, and Infrastructure teams.
Established a 'Subject Matter Expert' (SME) framework to decentralize knowledge and empower developers.

positions.summary: Full-stack development focused on distributed systems and on-premise deployments.
highlights: Developed internal tooling that automated repetitive tasks, saving substantial engineering hours weekly.
Managed complex on-premise deployments and architecture patterns.
